name: Coval L. Formy-Duval
description: In Whiteville, NC, Coval L. Formy-Duval raises Strawberries, Pumpkins, Corn, Tomatoes, and Peas on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, autumn, and summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
